caption: Isenfluh, Lauterbrunnen
composition: Wooden hamlet of Isenfluh on its terrace above the valley · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Isenfluh is the small wooden hamlet on a terrace at about 1091 metres above the Weisse Lütschine, in the municipality of Lauterbrunnen since 1973. Chalets line a quiet lane, and the valley drops away below. This is not the valley-floor view of Staubbach Falls and not Wengen or Mürren. The Open-Meteo model is heavily clouded and cool, about 11°C, with little wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
